title: Bengaluru techie compares salary vs career vs life in Dubai, USA, and India. His final verdict will surprise you
summary: A Bengaluru tech professional weighs salary, career prospects, lifestyle and tax burdens across Dubai, the USA and India. The short piece frames the trade-offs many workers consider when choosing where to live and work, and points readers to related stories about earnings, work culture and life choices.
content:
